header: An icon, a title and one sentence — repeated
lead: The default capability grid in two to four columns. The card variant gives every cell a surface, the plain variant takes it away, and nothing else about the cell changes.

items.title: Two to four columns
items.text: The count is an editor's choice, and the grid still reflows on the room it has rather than on the width of the viewport.

items.title: Card or plain
items.text: The variant adds or removes the card surface. Everything else — spacing, order, icon tile — stays exactly where it was.

items.title: Cells of equal height
items.text: Every cell stretches to the tallest of its row, which is what keeps the icon tiles on one optical line.

items.title: One link per cell
items.text: Give a cell a link and the whole cell becomes the target, with the title carrying the accessible name.
